messages:
marta: Quick sync — noticed a weird telemetry delta between canary and prod after the header-driven model selection rollout. latency p50 up ~8% for some tenants, but cost per token down. not evenly distributed. anyone else seeing header->model mapping being lossy?
ajay: I saw that too earlier. looks like when the gateway rewrites to alias v2 it drops the original requested model in the request trace, so console attribution lands on the routed model not the caller's hint. makes rollouts confusing.
sara: That explains it. we currently record the executed model only. for audits we need the requested alias + resolved model. propose adding an "X-Requested-Model" passthrough header that the gateway preserves.
leo: minor ask: can we keep it opt-in per-tenant? some customers rely on redaction and we don't want to leak alias how-to. default off and tenant-level toggle in console.
patrick: also need to consider quota accounting. If we record executed model for billing, switching to attribute to requested model will change unit economics. we should emits both metrics: billing_model and request_model. then roll console to show both side-by-side.
marta: agreed. plan: gateway adds passthrough header + audit header `X-Model-Routed: <alias>:<resolved>`; metrics pipeline emits `model.requested` and `model.executed` tags. rollout: stage in dev -> canary -> 10% tenants opt-in -> full.
ajay: one implementation detail — current route matcher mutates request.headers map in-place which causes downstream caching keys to change. careful: adding header could bust KV cache. maybe add header to tracing only (not to cache key) and keep a separate metadata bag.
sara: good catch. we can add header for tracing/audit to internal metadata blob attached to the request context and not to the public outgoing headers. gateway should still emit telemetry envelope with both values.
leo: on console UX: show a tiny delta indicator on route pages that surfaces differences like "avg p50 vs expected" and link to tenant's routing rules. helps SEs triage quickly.
patrick: +1. also add a regression alert in Optimize if model.requested != model.executed with >5% requests for a tenant.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/gateway-model-audit -> staging (CI ✅)
ops-bot: perf-test job started for gateway-model-audit on canary subnet (runs: 5000 requests across model families)
marta: can folks +1 the opt-in toggle and telemetry names so I can file the RFC? final names: `X-Model-Requested`, `X-Model-Resolved`, metrics tags `model.requested`, `model.executed`.
ajay: +1 on names, but prefer `X-Model-Requested` over `X-Requested-Model` for consistency with other headers.
sara: +1. will add unit tests for route matcher and an integration test for telemetry pipeline.
leo: +1 from infra/tenancy side for opt-in toggle.
patrick: leaving a note: when we do canary, add a short-lived fallback to legacy attribution for 24h so billing spikes can be reconciled.
marta: thanks all — I'll open RFC & small design doc and tag infra/telemetry. dropping TODOs into the thread soon. :thumbsup:
